title: Import parser fuzz and negative-input test corpus for PSD/VDJ/PressJSON
outcome: The PSD, VDJ and Press JSON import paths survive arbitrary malformed input without uncaught crashes outside their documented error handling: a checked-in fuzz/negative corpus plus a deterministic runner proves typed, user-safe failure for truncated, oversized, deeply-nested, wrong-mime and hostile-declaration inputs, and any proven parser defect found is fixed with the smallest safe change.
before: GOVERNOR.md Security Rules require defensive sanitization of imported/parsed files, and the truth ledger lists PSD/VDJ/PressJSON import as working on valid inputs with 'hardening remains backlog'. No fuzz or negative-input corpus exists in tests/. Builder must re-confirm parser entry points on current main (src/import/psd.ts, src/import/vdj.ts, Press JSON open path).
after: Deterministic fuzz/negative suite under tests/ runs the real parsers against a versioned corpus of malformed inputs; every failure is a caught, typed error; corpus, runner and any minimal fixes are merged together.
acceptance: Corpus covers at minimum: truncated files, wrong magic bytes, zero-length, oversized dimensions/counts, deep nesting, and JSON with hostile key/prototype pollution patterns for the Press JSON path.
Runner is deterministic (seeded) and completes in the normal unit-test time budget.
Every malformed input produces a caught, typed error or a safe rejection; zero uncaught exceptions escaping the parser boundary.
Valid-file import behavior unchanged: existing import-related tests and a real PSD round-trip stay green.
Any production fix is minimal and inside src/import/**; if a correct fix requires files outside src/import/** the builder stops and reports BLOCKED with the exact cross-domain dependency.
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted tests and npm run build pass.
evidence: Fuzz/negative suite output on the full corpus
Seeded determinism proof (two runs, identical results)

builder.notes: Claimable after VIRO-0005 releases the tests/** lease.

delta.before: No malformed-input corpus; parser robustness unproven beyond valid files.
delta.after: Versioned corpus + deterministic runner + typed-failure guarantee, with minimal fixes for proven defects.
regression_protection: Existing import/PSD tests and valid-file round-trip green
